name: read_scene
description: Read the current scene module, or its lines startLine to endLine. A reply that only reads gets the result and continues the turn; a reply that also edits ends it. Scene lines in a result start with their line number and a tab; leave that prefix out of oldString.

startLine.description: First line to read, 1-based. Omit to start at the top.

endLine.description: Last line to read, inclusive. Omit to read to the end.
